youtube.title: Why Soccer Balls Have Black Patches ⚽ #Shorts #science #facts #didyouknow
youtube.description:
A classic soccer ball is a truncated icosahedron: twelve pentagons and twenty hexagons. Hexagons alone tile a flat surface perfectly but cannot close into a sphere. Each pentagon forces the surface to curve, so twelve of them bend the pattern into a round ball. The black color was added so the pentagons were easier to see on early television.
